rules.content:
`comment("Splunk SPL for Insider-Enabled Account Fraud — Employee Access Anomaly")`
`comment("Detects out-of-portfolio account access with anomalous timing/volume followed by modifications")`
index=flame_banking sourcetype=flame:employee_audit
  (event_type="account_view" OR event_type="account_detail_access" OR event_type="account_modification")
  account_in_employee_portfolio="false"
| eval hour = strftime(_time, "%H")
| eval after_hours = if(hour < 8 OR hour > 18, 1, 0)
| stats dc(account_id) AS unique_accounts count AS total_events
    sum(after_hours) AS after_hours_events
    values(modification_type) AS modifications
    values(account_id) AS accounts_accessed
    BY employee_id, employee_role, employee_branch
| where unique_accounts > 10 OR after_hours_events > 0
| lookup employee_baseline employee_id OUTPUT baseline_daily_access
| eval deviation_multiple = unique_accounts / baseline_daily_access
| where deviation_multiple >= 3 OR after_hours_events > 0
| eval risk_score = case(
    deviation_multiple >= 5 AND after_hours_events > 3 AND isnotnull(modifications), "critical",
    deviation_multiple >= 3 AND isnotnull(modifications), "high",
    after_hours_events > 0 AND isnotnull(modifications), "high",
    1=1, "medium")
| table employee_id, employee_role, employee_branch, unique_accounts,
        deviation_multiple, after_hours_events, modifications,
        accounts_accessed, risk_score
| sort - risk_score
rules.title: DL-0164: Insider-Enabled Account Fraud — Employee Access Anomaly with Subsequent Account Changes (SPLUNK)
